main.*: {{MainIcon|alt=Challenge-Mode-Icon}} ''Revisit locations around Two Point County in new, challenging scenarios. Complete the challenge to receive a score, and tier, for your performance. Only the highest scores are awarded gold.'' '''Challenge Mode''' was introduced with version 2.0 of [[Two Point Campus]]. Similar in concept to the R.E.M.I. X Mode of [[w:c:two-point-hospital:Two Point Hospital|Two Point Hospital]], it features revised versions of the [[Campuses]] in the main game, with focused, often more difficult objectives, and modes of gameplay not elsewise found in the base game. In order to play Challenge Mode, the player will be required to gain Star Level {{s1}} in [[Freshleigh Meadows]]. [[File:Challenge-Mode-Main-Menu-Tooltip.png|right|200px]] Accessible from the Main Menu, Challenge Mode exists independent of any existing saved games. A tooltip will appear when the cursor is rested on the Challenge Mode button, with a summary of the player's progress. Pressing the button will take the player to the Challenge Select screen. {{clr}} ==Challenge Select== [[File:Challenge-Mode-Select-Challenge.png|left|200px]] [[File:Challenge-Mode-Running-Total.png|right|120px]] This screen is the main hub of challenge mode. Each Challenge will be represented by an image, with a [[File:Challenge-Mode-Empty-Icon.png|28px]] icon underneath the title. These will be replaced with a [[File:Challenge-Mode-Bronze-Icon.png|28px]], [[File:Challenge-Mode-Silver-Icon.png|28px]] or [[File:Challenge-Mode-Gold-Icon.png|28px]] as the player completes challenges and reaches each tier. [[File:Challenge-Mode-Inspector-1.png|right|150px]] In the top-right corner, the [[File:Challenge-Mode-Total-Icon.png|28px]] icon will indicate how many challenges the player has completed, and clicking on each challenge will reveal an inspector window with its details. [[File:Top-Tab-Challenge-Overview.png|left|50px]] On the Overview Tab, the player will be given an outline for the Challenge's storyline, below which is a summary of the goal that must be achieved. The High Score panel will be empty if the player has not played this challenge yet. [[File:Challenge-Mode-Inspector-2.png|right|150px]] Since the Challenge can be saved and resumed, any game in progress will be marked in a panel below this, showing how long it has been running. If this is the case, then also present will be "Continue" and "Restart" buttons, elsewise the "Start" button will begin the Challenge. [[File:Top-Tab-Overview.png|left|50px]] The Overall Score tab does precisely what it promises. Here will be displayed the requirements to reach each tier, and the player's current position, as well as that of any friends playing on the same platform. {{clr}} ==Reward Items== [[File:Challenge-Mode-Reward-Locked.png|left|250px]] {{Main|Challenge Mode Reward Items}} There are five decorative [[Items]] in the game, introduced on 20th November 2023, which are given as rewards for completing Challenge Mode Campuses. Before playing Challenge Mode, these will appear in the item list in Career Mode, but will appear locked, in the same way as items that are to be unlocked with [[Kudosh]]. To unlock these items, the player must achieve at least a [[File:Challenge-Mode-Bronze-Icon.png|28px]] rating in a number of Challenge Mode Campuses. Each one completed will unlock a new item, until all five are available. These items can then be placed in Career Mode, [[Sandbox Mode]], and Challenge Mode itself. {{clr}} {| class=tpcCMTable align=center ! rowspan=3 style="padding:5px;" width=150px | While several environments in [[Two Point Campus]] are familiar to players of [[w:c:two-point-hospital:Two Point Hospital|Two Point Hospital]], Mitton University is the only location revisited from that game. As before, it is the first [[Cold]] level in the game, and as such will introduce [[Heating Items]]. In an attempt to modernise the venerable institution, the administration of Mitton University have decided to invest in the [[Robotics]] [[Course]], with [[Internet History]] also becoming available to unlock. Two important facilities are also introduced: the [[Training Room]], allowing for the development of [[Staff]], and the [[Research Lab]], through which the player can acquire [[Equipment]] [[Upgrades]] and another Course, [[General Knowledge]]. In addition, the now-Education Minister, [[Tarquin Foxbridge]], will make his first (re)appearance, as will Roach Burger's corporate mascot, the [[Roach Burglar]]. '''Two Point County''' is the setting for both [[Two Point Campus]] and [[w:c:two-point-hospital:Two Point Hospital|Two Point Hospital]] before it.

In addition to this, it is also the name of Two Point Studios' [https://community.twopointcounty.com/ main community site]. Aside from keeping up with developments from Two Point Studios, one main advantage to signing up for a free account is to receive a free item in-game: the [[Royal Flush]]!
{{clrl}}
[[File:Golden-Toilet-BEHOLD.png|right|250px]]
==Registration==
*Visit the [https://community.twopointcounty.com/ Two Point County Community Site].
*Select '''Register''' in the upper-right corner.
*Complete the registration process (be sure to keep note of the username and password, these will be needed again soon).
*Once the account is created and verified through the confirmation email, return to the website and ensure the login is still active. If not, log back in.

==Logging In==
{| align=center style="padding-bottom:15px;" width=100%
|[[File:Two-Point-County-Logged-Out.png|center|200px]]
|[[File:Two-Point-County-Connecting.png|center|200px]]
|[[File:Two-Point-County-Logged-In.png|center|200px]]
|}
[[File:Two-Point-County-Form.png|left|200px]]
*Open up [[Two Point Campus]] on the player's chosen platform (the bonuses can be used simultaneously on any and all platforms on which the player owns the game.)
*In the bottom-right corner of the Main Menu can be seen the Two Point County logo, which should be marked as '''Logged Out'''.
*Click the '''Login''' button, to open the login panel.
*Enter the username and password created above, then press '''Login''' again.
*Once login is complete, the status panel will change to "Logged in" with a green background, and a version of the following popup should appear:
[[File:Two-Point-County-Successful-Login.png|right|200px]]
The '''[[Royal Flush]]''' package will certainly appear, and others are available too. If the player is subscribed to Amazon Prime and has been collecting codes for Two Point Campus, they may find instructions [[Amazon Prime Items#Unlock|here]] on how to add them to their Two Point County Community account.

==Accessing Items==
[[File:Two-Point-County-Items-Panel.png|150px|left]]
{{Main|Amazon Prime Items}}
For the Royal Flush (and any other acquired packages) to appear in-game, the player must always be logged in to Two Point County before accessing their saved game.

Once loaded into a [[Campus]], navigate to a [[Bathroom]] and press the [[File:Inspector-Button-Items.png|28px]] beneath its inspector to open up its Items panel. Here, the [[Royal Flush]] will appear. As a Two Point County item, it will appear on a [[File:Item-BG-TPCounty.png|28px]] style of background, to stand out from the [[File:Item-BG-Base.png|28px]] background used by Items in the base game.

Other Two Point County items, such as the [[Amazon Prime Items]], can be accessed in the appropriate room lists. For example, click the [[File:Interface-Main-Items.png|28px]] icon on the main interface and select the [[File:Side-Tab-Additional-Content.png|28px]] Additional Content tab to see all Two Point County items, as well as items from [[DLC]] packages such as [[Space Academy DLC|Space Academy]].

'''Note: '''It is possible for an updated build of the game to log the player out, so if these items disappear in-game, please return to the main menu and log back in for things to return to normal.

If a [[Campus]] was loaded without being logged in, and Two Point County-reliant items disappeared upon loading, they will still be gone if the level is saved, either manually or automatically. if this happens, the items can be replaced upon re-entering the level after a successful login.
